subject: E-Commerce
title: Fake Urgency Timers
description: A short lesson to help you apply Fake Urgency Timers.

hook.text: 'Sale ends in 2:34:17!' But refresh the page and the timer resets. Fake urgency is everywhere online.

buildup.text: Countdown timers trigger loss aversion and FOMO. They bypass rational thinking with manufactured panic.

discovery.text: Real urgency—like concert tickets—works honestly. Fake urgency uses timers that reset or never expire.

twist.text: The FTC is cracking down on fake urgency. Penalties can reach $50,000 per violation if timers are deceptive.

climax.text: Urgency works because humans evolved to respond to scarcity. Online sellers exploit ancient instincts.

punchline.text: Timer resets on refresh? It was never real. Fake urgency exploits ancient.

quiz.question: How can you tell if an urgency timer is fake?
options: It resets when you refresh the page or reopen the site
